overview.description: The Roundhill Weekly T-Bill ETF (WEEK) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund seeks to provide weekly distributions and stable NAV through an actively managed portfolio of US Treasury Bills with maturities of between 0 and 3 months. WEEK was launched on Mar 6, 2025 and is issued by Roundhill.
